summary: B (Strata Float hero) grounded on a lit tabletop, believable refraction and edge glow, the warm laminated base edge and metal feet give richness and scale, arm and pillars resolved; A (current studio hero) a blown white sweep, mushy wordmark, posterised acrylic, the lid takes half the frame. Against B: white bars and notches on the upper plate's front edge (the phono tunnel's openings seen through the edge) read as glitches.
